title: Parametric Building Envelope
description: Reusable SVG building shell with configurable floors, facade bays, openings, dimensions, and a cutaway that exposes floor plates.
learningObjectives: Relate building width, depth, floor count, and floor-to-floor height to overall envelope geometry.
Visualize repeated facade bays and openings while maintaining explicit dimensions.
Use a cutaway view to inspect floor plate elevations without implying code compliance.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: Candidate implementation includes deterministic geometry checks and source review. Independent engineering, live browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Reserved buildings-agent task bld-building-envelope; implemented as original dependency-free SVG/DOM source.
